title: Further Measures to Support Small Businesses, Especially Stallholders at Markets and Food Centres in Heartlands
what_it_is: Further Measures to Support Small Businesses, Especially Stallholders at Markets and Food Centres in Heartlands

sections.label: Support for market stallholders
sections.summary: The Government will announce plans in the 2025 Budget and Committee of Supply debates to further support stallholders at markets and hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The Government will announce plans to further support stallholders at markets and hawker centres in the 2025 Budget Statement and Committee of Supply debates.

sections.label: CDC Voucher Scheme hawker impact
sections.summary: The CDC Voucher Scheme is not administered by the Ministry, but spending patterns show which hawker stalls are more popular and suggest the scheme brings financial support to hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The CDC Voucher Scheme is not administered by my Ministry.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: By looking at the spending patterns, we know which hawker stalls are a lot more popular with residents as well, because they spend a lot more of their vouchers at these hawker stalls.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, I would say if I can extrapolate from that simple experience, I would think that the CDC Voucher Scheme does have an impact on bringing financial support to these hawkers through the spending patterns of our residents.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And I am sure at the Budget, more may be announced.
